data.name: Blazing War
data.detailed_description:
"Blazing War" is a 2D pixel-style survival action game set in a post-apocalyptic world, where you fight to survive amid radiation and danger.

Core Gameplay

You will be in a desolate world filled with radiation, where mutated creatures and hidden dangers lurk everywhere. Your goal is to survive by collecting resources, avoiding threats, and fighting wisely.

1. Movement & Control

Adopt 8-directional free movement (up, down, left, right, and four diagonals), with smooth inertia to ensure a realistic operating experience. Collision detection is enabled for walls, obstacles, and other objects to prevent passing through solid structures.

2. Combat Mechanism

Melee combat: Swing your weapon to attack enemies, with a short cooldown between attacks. Ranged combat: Use simple ranged weapons (with limited ammunition) to attack from a distance.

Enemy vision: Enemies have a conical field of vision; you can avoid detection by hiding behind cover.

3. Resource Collection

Search all interactive objects (such as boxes, cabinets, and abandoned equipment) to obtain supplies (ammo, medical kits, food) that are essential for survival.

4. Level Rules

Each level has clear objectives; complete the specified tasks (such as collecting key resources, eliminating target enemies) to pass. There is a time limit for each level—fail to complete the task within the time limit, and the challenge will be deemed a failure.

Game Features

  • 2D pixel style, with a dark and gritty post-apocalyptic aesthetic, restoring the sense of desolation and urgency.

  • Smooth operation: 8-directional movement, no lag, with clear feedback for every operation.

  • Strategic survival: Reasonably allocate resources and choose combat or stealth according to the situation to avoid unnecessary losses.

  • Simple and exciting: Easy to get started, with clear goals, allowing you to experience the fun of survival and combat.

data.short_description: A 2D top-down pixel wasteland survival game. Battle zombies, mutants and elite foes with melee and firearms. Clear unique level missions amid hidden traps. Loot supplies, upgrade your character and unlock skills. Beat objectives or bosses in time to survive the post-apocalyptic ruins.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: WINDOWS® 7, 8.1, 10 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel Celeron G1820 / AMD Athlon II X3 455
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 760 or AMD Radeon™ R7 260x with 2GB Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: WINDOWS® 7, 8.1, 10 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-3770 or AMD FX™-9590 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon™ RX 480 with 3GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Shader model 3.0，NVidia 7600，ATI X1600 Or higher
